title: LLMs reason directly on raw scientific data, approaching domain expert models

fields.title: LLMs reason directly on raw scientific data, approaching domain expert models
fields.author: Kejun Albert Ying
fields.description: Across 54 raw-record benchmarks and seven frontier models with zero tools and zero fine-tuning, general language models already beat entry specialists on 40 of 54 tasks and match or beat the median specialist on 39 of 54.
